name: infinite-canvas
description: Open Infinite Canvas in Chrome and inspect, edit, save, export, and run live canvas workflows from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Edit, save, export, and run live canvas workflows
interface.longDescription: Open the user's configured Infinite Canvas deployment in Chrome, upload user-authorized local media as private asset nodes, inspect and precisely edit nodes, edges, groups, layout, and selections, then save, export, run, cancel, or retry the authenticated workflow without bypassing canvasStore.
defaultPrompt: Upload my local media files as connected canvas asset nodes.
Inspect my active Infinite Canvas and summarize its workflow.
Add and connect nodes on my active Infinite Canvas.
Repair incorrect connections, then save and export the selected workflow.
Choose a suitable model and aspect ratio, then arrange the workflow cleanly.
Run selected nodes, cancel or retry failures when needed, and monitor the execution.
